about:
THE STORM DRAINS review views (tools/bake/sewers/review.py renders them; tools/review/render.py's format). Make: lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/bake/sewers.luau; for each pipe, lune run tools/bake/sewers/review.luau --pipe

; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/bake/sewers/review.py --pipe

. 'pipe' says which scene a view belongs to. Inside a pipe the eye is a squirrel's (a stud over the walkway, on the route's lane); from the pavement a person's. Every lamp is lit (the client lights a space while a squirrel is in it) and the owner's modules are drawn from the FBX files that were uploaded, where the engine pivots them. A view with "window": true draws the owner's modules only within Client/World/SewerArt's radius (48 studs) of the eye, as the game does for a squirrel inside (the lining hidden there); "_parts" views draw the parts lining, the fall-back when a module does not load; views from outside draw the lining, as the game does for anyone not in the drain.
